decisions.subject: China book
decisions.lean: HK book held at ~68% invested / ~32% cash — a disciplined quality rebalance, not an aggressive deployment. Doctrine is confirmation over prediction: the China desk reads HK as an acute risk-off fear washout (breadth collapsing, weak HKD peg, southbound outflows) that is vulnerable to a bounce IF global risk stabilizes — but that turn is NOT yet confirmed, so I keep a real cash cushion rather than front-run it. The book is a barbell. Quality washout / FXI-parity leg: Tencent (0700.HK, lifted to 17% as the lowest-beta way to own the working tech momentum) and SMIC (0981.HK, top desk score 100 but entry extended so I hold a core, don't chase). Defensive carry leg: China Life (2628.HK), ICBC (1398.HK) and a NEW China Construction Bank (0939.HK) that replaces Bank of China — a like-for-like quality upgrade (conviction 95 vs ballast, bigger FXI weight) that keeps financials weight flat rather than deepening the crowded 98th-pctile bank trade. Mean-reversion call-options on a bounce, all trimmed and on short leashes: Kuaishou (1024.HK, crushed high-beta growth), CMOC (3993.HK, copper/gold re-risk but fighting negative momentum + a strong dollar) and a Chow Tai Fook (1929.HK) gold-jewellery stub. I leaned into the best quality (Tencent) and cut the weakest theses, respecting the unconfirmed HK turn.
decisions.thesis: Exited Bank of China (3988.HK) entirely and rotated the proceeds into China Construction Bank (0939.HK) — a quality/conviction upgrade within the same megabank sleeve (CCB conviction 95 BOTTOMING and a larger FXI weight vs BoC ballast), keeping total financials exposure flat so I do not deepen the crowded 98th-pctile bank trade. Trimmed CMOC (3993.HK 7.5%->6%, negative nonferrous momentum + dollar headwind), Chow Tai Fook (1929.HK 6.1%->4%, thin consumer thesis) and Kuaishou (1024.HK 7.4%->6%, cut high-beta risk). Added ~2pts to Tencent (0700.HK) and ~1pt to China Life (2628.HK), the two highest-conviction names. Net cash little changed (~32%), respecting an HK turn that is not yet confirmed.
